build_outbound_message_dict: build an outbound message dict with sender, recipient, message text, and phase fields
build_message_dict: build a message dict with sender, recipient, message, phase, and time_sent fields
build_draw_vote_message_dict: build a draw vote message dict for a sender in a given phase with timestamp
is_phase_name: check if a string matches the phase name pattern like A1901A or COMPLETED
get_last_message: get the last message sent in a game by iterating phases in reverse order
